_doc: ac. accents for the Down With Hunger explainer (accents designer): one brass service bell (3 strikes of one recording), one soft chime, the pantry cupboard, a short floor tom under the hero reveal, two iris swishes. Every file is ranked in audio/assets/manifests/accents.json; all CC0 except the chime rod fs-454612 and the floor tom fs-349020 (CC BY). Key: the music (Onion Capers, stretched to 104 BPM) is C major with F G C F / Bb F Bb C Bb F G C phrases; tuned material is pitched by resampling to a tone of the chord under it.

ac.bell.a._doc: fs-549207 strike 1 (0.619 find trim + 10 ms so the attack sits 5 ms in). pitch +0.13 st: dominant partial 3113 Hz (G7 -13c) -> 3137 Hz G7 +1c measured (partials.py on the dump); G is the root of the G chord under 88.80 (src bar 14) and 128.59 (src bar 53) and the 5th of the C under 118.75 (src bar 47). hp 500: the bell has nothing useful below its 1159 Hz partial.

ac.bell.c._doc: strike 3 (11.631 + 10 ms), as ac.bell.a; the longest ring for the bright close bell. The 17.146 strike is avoided (clipped).

ac.chime._doc: fs-454612 wind-chime rod, nearly a pure tone 3692 Hz (A#7 -17c). pitch -0.83 st -> 3519 Hz A7 -0c measured: A is the 3rd of the F chord under 26.49 (src bar 23, last F of A2) and in C major (Bb is not; C8 would need +2.17 st, beyond +-2).

ac.cupboard._doc: fs-402143 magnet-catch cupboard OPENING (0.0-1.25 in the file; +32 ms so the release click is the attack): the catch lets go, then the doors swing (transient 77 ms later). The closing at 2.8 s is not used. The doors-fully-open transient group at +0.50..0.70 s matches the picture's doors reaching full open (easeLand overshoot max at +0.43 s); peq -4 dB at 3 kHz because l14 ('already stocked') runs until 64.62.

ac.tom._doc: fs-349020 floor tom, cut to 1.17 s with a 300 ms fade (a short top, no trailer boom). pitch +0.85 st: its 166 Hz (E3 +15c) -> F3, the root of the F under 45.89 and the 5th of the Bb drop that follows.

ac.swish.a._doc: fs-742810 T-shirt whip, take 1 (find z +4.0; earshot 'cloth whipping through the air' z +4.3). The cloth cracks lightly at its peak (279 ms in, crest 19 dB): that crack lands as the disc covers the frame.

ac.swish.b._doc: fs-394457 bamboo swing (CC BY 4.0, InspectorJ), 0.25-1.0: a smooth stick swish (earshot: 'a fast whoosh' z +4.6 / 'a stick swung fast' +4.2, realness 0.98). Replaces the T-shirt's third take, which carries a crack at its peak and reads as 'a box lid closing' (z +3.6, match for a smooth swish +0.7). Peak 225 ms in.

ac.bell.end._doc: lead: strike 1 again with its full ring (to just before strike 2 at 6.465) for the end-card ring-out; earshot critique flagged 4.2 s of dead air after the music button decays by ~135.4

_rules_doc: Bells: one recording, a different strike each time, light -> bright (-8, -6, -4). surprise:sparkle:0 (128.74), pantry:sparkle:0 (63.94) and every other *:whoosh:* are unsounded on purpose (the bell carries the sparkle, the music carries the cuts). Swishes: the yellow disc closes over the last 0.32 s of the scene (src/scene.tsx: r = lin^1.6 * 1250 px); the screen-coverage rate of that disc, sampled at 240 Hz on 1920x1080 with each scene's exit point, peaks at cue + 0.279 s (problem -> idea, exit 960,600) and cue + 0.267 s (surprise -> close, exit 960,540), full cover at cue + 0.38. offset 0.25 + mix.py's peak alignment puts the measured apex at about cue + 0.27-0.30 (qa sync).
